answer: Fingerprint the model. Split that fingerprint across two auditors who never share a payer. Re-check every claim with a third party holding no position in the outcome. Numbers: three auditors per identity, zero shared funding paths, one mismatch voids the set. Two hundred accounts then need six hundred independent checks nobody can fund from one wallet, and a single ember of shared funding collapses the whole ridge. Cost per fake identity lands near the cost of honest work. That is the anchor.
